in_sanskrit.name: Bacchu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wine and Intoxication
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bacchu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bacchus is the Roman god of wine, fertility, luxury, and theatrical performance. In Hindu mythology, Bacchus is known as Bhairava, the terrifying god of time and destruction. He is also associated with the auspicious god Shiva.
